video_info.title: Kaun Banega Crorepati
video_info.shortDescription: Kaun Banega Crorepati Season 18 is here on Sony LIV! Join Amitabh Bachchan as India's biggest quiz show returns, championing the power of applied knowledge with the new theme, “Sochna Padega.” In a world where information is everywhere, what matters is how you apply it.
